name: Refinishing During Seattle's Rainy Season
title-tag: Refinishing Hardwood in Seattle's Rainy Season: A Guide
meta-description: Floors get refinished in Seattle from October to May — waterborne finish cures off your furnace, not the sky. The rainy-season playbook from a local crew.
post-summary: December 4, 2026 · Hardwood gets refinished right through Seattle’s rainy season — a heated house gives waterborne finish the same conditions in January as July. What the wet months actually change: moisture readings before sanding, heat through the job, and why oil-modified poly is the one chemistry that should wait for summer.
